subject: prd/existing-repo-onboarding
statement: When apply is re-run against an already-applied plan, the system shall land only content that has drifted from the plan, making no other change.
rationale: idempotent re-apply inherits SCAF-2 (F-4); the basis for UB-4's re-adopt
fit_criterion: a second apply of the fixture plan lands zero further changes
